english.meaning: to be found in; to consist in, as the reason or key point
english.note: 貴在餅帶 means the expense lies in the cartridges. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: So you mean Nintendo is expensive because of the cartridges…
exampleSentences.traditional: 即係你意思係任天堂貴𠻺貴在餅帶…
